title: NAACL 2027 Student Research Workshop
institution: NAACL 2027 (Nations of the Americas Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics)
about: The NAACL 2027 Student Research Workshop invites research papers and thesis proposals from students. Papers are submitted through OpenReview by 11 January 2027 (11:59 PM AoE). The workshop runs alongside NAACL 2027 in San Francisco, 1 to 5 June 2027.
requirements: First author must be a current student or have completed the work while a student; proof of student status required at submission
